note: Words Augustine may use only a limited number of times per article. Code counts them in the section text and short description (not in quotations taken from sources); an article over a limit is sent back to be rewritten, and if it is still over after the last try it goes to review with the count shown. Add a line when you notice another word that appears too often; no code change is needed. 'pattern' is a case-insensitive regular expression. 'instead' lists wording the writer may use in place of the extra uses; it is given to him before he writes and again if he goes over. A synonym can become the next overused word: if one does, add it here as its own limit.

limits.why: Tom likes the word but it is overused. Measured 2026-10-09 across the 453 existing articles: 56 uses in 48 articles, up to 5 in one.
The whole family (quiet, quietly, quietness...) was in 111 of the 453 existing articles, 13 of them three or more times, up to 6 in one.
